Name: Seasonal Outfits - DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour Luau Fix
Author: ShadowheartSimp69
Description:
[color=#d8d8d8][size=5][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Marnie's sprite from [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] [color=#d8d8d8]does not match the colour scheme of [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url][color=#d8d8d8] when Marnie is mixing the Luau pot. This mod fixes that.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Extract into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods [/i]and overwrite Seasonal Outfits files.[/color]

[color=#d8d8d8][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Should be compatible with everything that doesn't overwrite Seasonal Outfits' Marnie sprite changes. [/color]
[color=#d8d8d8]Not tested with other recolours.[/color]
